spans.s:
m. (-ट्टिः)
Childish fancy, whim, caprice.
E.
अ neg. and खट to desire, undesirable by the wise.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
All, entire.
E.
अ neg. and खण्ड a part.

Leaving entire.
3 Admitting, non-refutation.
E.
अ neg. खडि to break, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unbroken, undivided.
2 Undisturbed, uninterrupted, continuous.
3 Unrefuted.
E.
अ neg. खण्डित divided.

mfn. (-र्त्तुः-र्त्तुः-र्त्तु)
Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season.
E.
अ neg. खण्डित broken, and ऋतु season.

mn. (-तः-तं)
1 A natural pond or lake.
2 A pool before a temple. Sometimes written आखात.
E.
अ neg. and खात dug.

mn. (-तः-तं)
A natural pond: see अखात.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Improper to be eaten.
E.
अ neg. खाद्य to be eaten.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uneaten.
E.
अ neg. खादित eaten.

m. (-खः)
A spade, a hoe.
E.
आङ्, खन to dig, ड aff.

m. (-लः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
आङ् and खण्ड to break, अलच् affix; mountain-breaking, foe-destroying.

m. (-नः)
1 A spade.
3 A digger.
E.
आङ्, खन to dig, घ aff.

m. (-नः)
1 A spade.
2 A digger.
E.
आङ्, खन to dig, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A thief.
2 A rat.
3 A hog.
4 A spade.
5 A digger, a ditcher, a miner.
E.
आङ्, खन to dig, and इकन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A spade.
2 A digger.
E.
आङ्, before खन to dig, इकविक aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A spade.
2 A digger.
E.
आङ्, खन to dig, डर aff.
